label: Whatever has a good-general favouring apprehends some content
paraphrase: OPEN cognition criterion, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every bearer x that has the real determination that its own favouring is a good-general profile phi (its favouring of candidates, at least one not a present input, depends on their betterness with end-realization held fixed) itself apprehends some content that is about some candidate. It is stated without reference to persons and applies in the same way to rational exercise and to an impersonal good-general nature. Its two marks each exclude one known noncognitive directed relation: a disposition or law whose selection factors through its own fixed end content, and a comparator that responds only to present inputs (CriterionTable). Whether any noncognitive relation meets both marks is the point the impersonal good-general rival denies.
